bio.text: Donald DeWitte, a Republican, is the state senator for Illinois' 33rd Senate District; according to his office biography he has served since his appointment in September 2018.

The biography says that before the Senate he was mayor of St. Charles from 2005 to 2013, a St. Charles alderman from 1993 to 2005, and a Regional Transportation Authority board member representing Kane County from 2013 to 2018.
It says he attended Elgin Community College and the University of Illinois at Springfield and then spent four decades in the building materials industry.
